sentences.en: These legends should be handed down to our offspring.
sentences.zh: 这些传说应该传给我们的后代。

sentences.en: Parents can pass many diseases on to their offspring.
sentences.zh: 父母可能会把很多疾病遗传给孩子。

sentences.en: A chick is the offspring of a rooster and a hen.
sentences.zh: 小鸡是公鸡和母鸡的产物。

senses.zh: （人的）后代，子女；（动物的）幼崽，崽兽；结果，产物
